episode_title: Quit Basing Multi-million Dollar Campaigns on Bad Customer Insights

real_qa.q: What is the persistent business challenge cycle that brands experience with their research teams?
real_qa.r: The persistent business challenge cycle occurs when a brand team identifies a business challenge, the research team executes a plan, insights are delivered, a solution is built and executed in market, but it fails to deliver expected volume growth. The same business challenge reappears the following fiscal year—sometimes with different wording—and the research team executes another research plan, repeating the same ineffective cycle year after year.
real_qa.requete: persistent business challenge cycle brand research

real_qa.q: What is the difference between inform work methodologies and inspire work insights in market research?
real_qa.r: Inform work methodologies are quantifiable, representative, and answer predetermined questions to reduce uncertainty in decision-making. Inspire work completely reframes business challenges so decision makers see new possibilities. The key difference is that inform work can be measured against predetermined success criteria and thus can be automated, while inspire work cannot be held to a predetermined measure of success and therefore cannot be automated. Most research teams spend time on inform work when they actually need inspire work to uncover untapped brand growth.
real_qa.requete: inform work vs inspire work research insights

real_qa.q: What is the 95-5 rule in consumer decision-making and how does it affect market research validity?
real_qa.r: The 95-5 rule states that approximately 95% of every consumer decision occurs below conscious awareness in the non-conscious part of the brain, while only about 5% occurs in conscious awareness. When researchers ask consumers why they buy a brand, they receive answers from the post-rationalized 5% rather than from the 95% that actually drives behavior. Getting to the 95% requires different research structures and methodologies than traditional inform work approaches.

real_qa.q: What percentage of grocery store product categories show signs of stagnation according to 2025 industry data?
real_qa.r: According to 2025 industry data, 45 to 48 percent of product categories in grocery stores already meet two of four signs of stagnation: shoppers buying only on price, very little to no differentiation recognized by consumers, lack of loyalty, and private label brands stealing share and being seen at parity with national brands. By 2035, this is projected to exceed 50% of categories, and any brand showing two of four stagnation signs will lose 20 to 30% of market value.

real_qa.q: How does Story Legacy use storytelling and AI to uncover brand resonance instead of just relevance?
real_qa.r: Story Legacy uses facilitated storytelling to engage consumers in sharing their lived experiences, which reveals what is emotionally meaningful to them at an unconscious level. A proprietary AI model then codes the qualitative stories into five specific variables, converting qualitative data into structured data that brands can activate. This approach shifts brands from pursuing relevance (a cognitive 5% question) to resonance (a non-conscious, emotional 95% experience) that cannot be duplicated by competitors.
real_qa.requete: Story Legacy storytelling AI brand resonance

real_qa.q: What insight drove a 13% sales increase for a board game company facing competition from video games?
real_qa.r: The board game company learned that medium and light household parents define quality time as any time the family is together (including passive activities like watching movies), while heavy household parents define quality time as any time the family is actively interacting with each other. By creating a communication platform that shifted medium and light households' attitudes toward quality time to align more closely with heavy households, the company achieved a 13% increase in sales in the first 12-week promotional period.
real_qa.requete: board game company 13 percent sales increase quality time
